note: Records the budget decisions; bounds nothing. Since 2026-09-27 nothing in the plan is capped: backlog_cap and per_run_discovered_sections are null (no cap). A section a campaign files on its own still carries an `**Origin:** discovered run=<id> <YYYY-MM-DD>` line, for provenance and reporting only. The live values must equal the latest history snapshot; history is append-only (entries 1 to 3 are schema 1 snapshots with the retired phase ceilings, entry 4 is the schema 2 snapshot with the retired caps); a raise, removing a cap included, needs approved_by operator and the operator's words quoted in reason. The safeguards that replaced the caps (no drop without operator approval, the release-time backlog gate) are checked on todo/backlog.md. Format and rules: todo/README.md, The budget and the backlog.

history.change: Initial budget. Each phase's ceiling is its section count after the legacy-roadmap sections nothing else needed moved to todo/backlog.md (B-001 to B-036), plus 10 percent rounded up with a minimum of one: 134 sections against a total ceiling of 154. Backlog cap 150; at most 3 new sections per phase run.
history.reason: Operator decision 2026-09-26: "the plan must not grow unconditionally". The operator set the ceilings to each phase's count after the roadmap move "+10% rounded up, minimum +1", with "backlog_cap: 150, per_run_new_sections: 3".

history.change: Nodus parity: ten new phases (4 to 13) for the Illustrator and CorelDRAW parity catalog, ceilings at each phase's section count plus 10 percent rounded up with a minimum of one (209 in all); the old Phase 9 (Nodus after 0.1.0) leaves the plan with its ceiling of 9 after its eight D02 T06 rows move into the parity phases; old Phases 4 to 8 become 14 to 18, old 10 and 11 become 19 and 20. Net raise 200, total ceiling 354.
history.reason: Operator decision 2026-09-26: "For Nodus, we need to add all(and I mean), all CorelDraw features and All Illustrator Features." Budget raise approved in the operator's words: "New parity phases, up to +200".

history.change: Imago parity: twelve new phases (16 to 27) for the Photoshop, Affinity Photo, and GIMP parity catalog, ceilings at each phase's section count plus 10 percent rounded up with a minimum of one (201 in all); D03 T07 §3, §16, and §17 move into Phases 21 and 27 while D03 T07 §11 stays; old Phases 16 to 20 become 28 to 32 with their ceilings unchanged. D00 T01 §7 joins Phase 0 within its ceiling. Net raise 201, total ceiling 555.
history.reason: Operator decision 2026-09-26: "now, imago, all the photoshop and at least 2 other similar popular programs of the same type. All features without leaving anything behind." The programs chosen are Photoshop, Affinity Photo, and GIMP 3. Budget raise approved in the operator's words: "New Imago parity phases, up to +250".

history.change: Phase ceilings and the total ceiling removed: operator-directed planning (sections written in attended sessions at the operator's request, which is every section in the tree today) is never capped. The per-run cap now counts only sections a campaign files on its own, marked by an `**Origin:** discovered run=<id> <date>` line, at most 15 per phase run (per_run_new_sections 3 renamed per_run_discovered_sections and raised to 15), with no shared pool. Backlog cap 150 -> 500. Schema 2: the snapshot carries backlog_cap and per_run_discovered_sections only.
history.reason: Operator decision 2026-09-27: "Why is there a phase limit on planning, should the limit not only be on new sections beign created automatically, but even then that shoiuld not be a small limit". The operator chose "15 per phase run", "No pool, per-run cap only", and for the backlog "Raise to 500".

history.change: Both remaining caps removed: per_run_discovered_sections 15 -> none and backlog_cap 500 -> none (schema 3: both null). Classes run-cap-exceeded and backlog-over-cap retired. Origin lines stay, for provenance and reporting only (query growth and query budget report discovered sections by run). In their place: no backlog entry leaves todo/backlog.md without a trace (promotion, a merge marker on the survivor, or an operator removal record; backlog-dropped), and every release section runs a backlog review for its app before it stamps (release-backlog-review-missing, release-backlog-unreviewed).
history.reason: Operator decision 2026-09-27: "the cap is worrying me, because I'm worried features will be left behind." The operator chose "No drop without operator approval", "Remove the backlog cap", "Release-time backlog gate", and "Remove the 15-per-run cap too".
